title: The Entomology of Hollow Knight
content: In 2019, American Entomologist published “Entomoludology: Arthropods in Video Games” (Shelomi 2019). In the article, I examined all the possible ways insects, arachnids, and myriapods had appeared thus far in video games, as protagonists or antagonists or background non-player characters, and what this could tell us about the cultures that made and played them. I included a database of approximately 679 games or game franchises that included insects, which I knew would not be complete, but which I hoped covered the most important representatives, and certainly every game in which the player is an insect themself.
